description.zh: 用于保证请求的幂等性，防止重复提交请求。由客户端生成该参数值，保证在不同请求间唯一，大小写敏感、不超过64个ASCII字符。
description.en: A client token that is used to ensure the idempotence of the request. The client generates the token, but you must make sure that the token is unique among different requests. The token is case-sensitive and must not exceed 64 ASCII characters in length.

description.zh:
DBLink的源集群ID。

> 您可以通过[DescribeDBClusters](~~173433~~)接口查看PolarDB集群列表。
description.en:
The ID of the source cluster for the DBLink.

> You can call the [DescribeDBClusters](~~173433~~) operation to query the list of PolarDB clusters.

description.zh:
DBLink名称。

- 由小写字母、数字、下划线（_）其中一到三种组成，必须包含小写字母。
- 以字母开头，字母或数字结尾。
- 长度不超过64个字符。
description.en:
The name of the DBLink.

- It must contain lowercase letters, and can also contain digits and underscores (\_).

- It must start with a letter and end with a letter or a digit.

- It must be no more than 64 characters in length.

description.zh:
地域ID。

> 可通过接口[DescribeRegions](~~98041~~)查看地域信息详情。
description.en:
The region ID.

> You can call the [DescribeRegions](~~98041~~) operation to query the details of regions.
The ID of the resource group.

description.zh:
源数据库名称。

> 您可以通过[DescribeDatabases](~~173558~~)接口查询PolarDB集群中的数据库信息。
description.en:
The name of the source database.

> You can call the [DescribeDatabases](~~173558~~) operation to query information about databases in a PolarDB cluster.

description.zh:
目标数据库账号。

> 您可以通过[DescribeAccounts](~~173549~~)接口查看PolarDB集群的数据库账号。
description.en:
The account of the destination database.

> You can call the [DescribeAccounts](~~173549~~) operation to query the database accounts of a PolarDB cluster.

description.zh:
DBLink的目标集群ID。

> - 如果目标为ECS自建Oracle数据库，该参数请传入`null`。
> - 您可以通过[DescribeDBClusters](~~173433~~)接口查看PolarDB集群列表。
description.en:
The ID of the destination cluster for the DBLink.

> - If the destination is a self-managed Oracle database that runs on an ECS instance, set this parameter to `null`.
>
> - You can call the [DescribeDBClusters](~~173433~~) operation to query the list of PolarDB clusters.

description.zh:
目标数据库名称。

> 您可以通过[DescribeDatabases](~~173558~~)接口查询PolarDB集群中的数据库信息。
description.en:
The name of the destination database.

> You can call the [DescribeDatabases](~~173558~~) operation to query information about databases in a PolarDB cluster.

description.zh: 目标数据库账号的密码。
description.en: The password for the destination database account.
The IP address of the self-managed Oracle database that runs on an ECS instance.
The port number of the self-managed Oracle database that runs on an ECS instance.

description.zh:
VPC ID。

> 可通过接口[DescribeVpcs](~~35739~~)查看VPC信息详情。
description.en:
The ID of the virtual private cloud (VPC).

> You can call the [DescribeVpcs](~~35739~~) operation to query the details of VPCs.

descriptions.zh:
DBLink可以连接两个PolarDB PostgreSQL版（兼容Oracle）集群，也可以连接PolarDB PostgreSQL版（兼容Oracle）集群和ECS自建PostgreSQL数据库。您可以通过DBLink跨集群查询数据。

> - 一个集群最多可创建10条DBLink。
> - DBLink的源集群和目标集群均会占用自身1条DBLink。
> - 源集群与目标集群或目标ECS必须位于同一个地域。
descriptions.en:
A DBLink provides connectivity between two PolarDB for PostgreSQL (Oracle-compatible) clusters, or between a PolarDB for PostgreSQL (Oracle-compatible) cluster and a self-managed PostgreSQL database on an Elastic Compute Service (ECS) instance. This lets you query data across clusters.

> - Each cluster supports a maximum of 10 DBLinks.
>
> - A DBLink consumes one DBLink quota from both the source cluster and the destination cluster.
>
> - The source cluster and the destination cluster or destination ECS instance must be in the same region.
